title: HLA-Net: A Physics-Guided Skeleton-Based Framework for Automatic Gravitational Arc Detection in Astronomical Images
abstract: arXiv:2611.05438v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Gravitational arcs produced by strong gravitational lensing provide a unique approach for investigating dark matter distribution, galaxy cluster mass reconstruction and the structure of the Universe. Automated detection remains challenging because gravitational arcs are rare, often faint and morphologically similar to elongated galaxies.In this paper, we propose \textbf{HLA-Net (Hybrid Lens Arc Network)}, an interpretable multi-stage framework for automatic gravitational arc detection that explicitly exploits both the geometric morphology and physical characteristics of gravitational lensing without requiring manually annotated training datasets.The proposed framework was evaluated on astronomical FITS images containing complex galaxy cluster structures. Starting from 169 initial arc candidates extracted from ordered skeleton representations, the multi-stage verification pipeline reduced the search space to 83 geometrically consistent

translated_title: HLA-Net：一种基于物理引导的骨架化框架，用于天文图像中引力弧的自动检测
translated_abstract: 强引力透镜产生的引力弧为研究暗物质分布、星系团质量重建以及宇宙结构提供了独特的途径。由于引力弧非常稀少、通常较为暗淡，且在形态上与拉长的星系相似，其自动检测仍然具有挑战性。在本文中，我们提出了HLA-Net（混合透镜弧网络），这是一个可解释的多阶段自动引力弧检测框架，它显式地利用了引力透镜的几何形态和物理特性，而无需人工标注的训练数据集。该框架在包含复杂星系团结构的天文FITS图像上进行了评估。从有序骨架表示中提取的169个初始弧候选开始，多阶段验证流程将搜索空间缩减至83个几何一致的候选对象。
tldr: 提出了一种无需人工标注数据的可解释多阶段框架HLA-Net，通过结合引力透镜的几何形态与物理特性，实现天文图像中引力弧的自动检测，并将候选搜索空间从169个缩减至83个。
en_tdlr: HLA-Net is an interpretable, physics-guided multi-stage framework that automatically detects gravitational arcs in astronomical images by exploiting lensing geometry and physical characteristics, requiring no manually annotated training data.
